args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion
when parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade to the fixed version
2.9.4 on the same 2.x line.

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to **2.9.4** in `requirements.txt` to address a high-severity security vulnerability.

## Security

- **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: `<2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`)
- Fixed in: `2.9.4` or `3.1.0`
- We chose 2.9.4, the patched release on the existing 2.x line, to keep the change minimal.

## Testing

- CI run on this branch passed (`ci-0001`).

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`
